NANDROLONE DECANOATE INJECTION | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India -> Ashkhabad, TURKMENSTAN | HS 30049099 | BOL 8138240". Further dated rows seen: 2025-11-07 NHAVA SHEVA SEA -> Poti, GEORGIA, HS 30049099, BOL 5507677; 2025-11-06 NHAVA SHEVA SEA -> Poti, GEORGIA, HS 30049099, BOL 5907675; 2025-08-23 NHAVA SHEVA SEA -> ASHKHABAD, GEORGIA, HS 30049079, BOL 1434470; 2025-08-22 NHAVA SHEVA SEA -> ASHKHABAD, GEORGIA, HS 30049069, BOL 1465467. Counter vs rows: page claims 140 total shipments; only 5 individual shipment rows were actually rendered in the free view (plus aggregated buyer/supplier/port tables: NHAVA SHEVA SEA 16, Ashkhabad 16). Buyers listed include IP AFYYET (128 shipments), THE MAIN PHARMACEUTICAL ASSOCIATION (254), SAGLYK IE. (58) — Turkmenistan addresses.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: real Indian customs shipping-bill records with dates (Aug–Dec 2025), destination (Turkmenistan, Georgia), HS codes and B/L numbers, all ex NHAVA SHEVA SEA. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS 820770/820780/820900/853890 (metalworking/machine-tool tooling and switchgear parts) does NOT match the actual shipments, which are 100% pharmaceuticals (HS 30049099, 30049079, 30049069 — medicaments). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 3004xx (pharmaceuticals), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) is contradicted by the shipment record — the company is a pharma trader/exporter. Role appears to be trader (it appears as shipper/consignor alongside multiple Indian manufacturers such as SR MEDICARE, SR PHARMACEUTICAL INDUSTRIES, AKRITI PHARMACEUTICALS, BKRS PHARMA, SRB INTERNATIONAL), so role = trader. Domestic supply evidence: NOT FOUND — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record could be retrieved; DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) and zaubacorp returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found (absence of evidence, not evidence of absence). Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public in the free views, not invented. PAN AACCU2055Q unverified (registry access blocked). Second slug variant 'unaraa-international-pvt-ltd' returned an empty page (no records), so the confirmed data rests on the single slug above.
